yeu_cau:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
• At least 4 years of hands-on experience in .NET development. 
• Deep knowledge of .NET Core, Entity Framework / ORM, and C#.
• Strong foundation in Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and MVC frameworks.
• Practical experience applying SOLID principles, with solid skills in Unit Testing and Integration 
Testing.
• Experience working within Scrum methodology and/or using CI/CD tools to deploy projects to 
production.
• Experience with relational databases, particularly MS SQL Server and Oracle.
• Hands-on experience with Docker (containerization, image building, deployment workflows).
• Able to write technical designs (system/module-level architecture, API design, database schema) 
based on business requirements.
• At least 1 year of experience with Azure Cloud Services - familiarity with a subset of the following is 
sufficient (not all required): 
o Virtual Machines
o Blob Storage / File Storage
o Load Balancer
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Active Directory
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps Services
o Container Registry
o Azure Monitor / Log Analytics / Application Insights
o API Management
 
Nice to have
• Understanding of microservice architecture principles and design patterns.
• Azure Certification (e.g., AZ-204, AZ-400, AZ-104) is a plus.
• Experience in the Banking / Finance domain is a plus. 
• Experience using AI models/tools (e.g., Copilot, LLM-assisted coding) to support and accelerate 
development work.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. 
• Good communication skills for cross-functional collaboration (QA, PM, Frontend teams). 
• Ability to work independently and within a team in an Agile environment.
